shortDescription: GitHub-style user profile overview view for a developer portfolio.
fullDescription: Renders the user-profile-overview view in its default state with a dark GitHub-style top header, profile sidebar, interactive repository navigation tabs, a popular repositories grid, and a yearly contribution activity section with selectable years and clickable heatmap cells. The view exposes state, activeTab, and selectedYear arguments so the profile overview can preserve supported visual states while keeping visible controls immediately interactive through local presentational state.
